mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used for every connection with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included. It also says HTTPS is used for every connection, with no exceptions.

Those two statements come from the project's recorded decisions #23 and #26. I left out the retired notes about disabling verification in dev builds and about plain http for internal hosts.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.

Muninn's session-start context also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it. The records I relied on were still readable.
